source_clause: EDPR1.2) Memory seat status is not available if vehicle is not equipped with memory seats.
leaf_desc_037: EDPR1.2) Memory seat status is not available if vehicle is not equipped with memory seats.
reasoning: 驗證目標：9.1.2（EDPR1.2）—— 未配備記憶座椅之車輛不顯示記憶座椅狀態。關鍵情境條件：車輛配置為條件本身，列 pre-condition。為什麼這樣切：已配備車輛之記憶座椅狀態與其操作屬 9.5.x 之 leaf，本 TC 只驗其不存在。

tcs.tc_title: Memory seat status hidden when seats are not equipped
tcs.test_item: Memory seat status hidden when seats are not equipped
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is not equipped with memory seats
2. A Driver Profile is active
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the “Edit Profile” tab
2. Read the option list and check that no memory seat status is shown
tcs.expected_result:
1. The “Edit Profile” tab is displayed
2. No memory seat status is available in the list
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
